visual_prior_specs.name: search_button_hitbox_overlay
visual_prior_specs.content_description: The provided toolbar screenshot with a bounding box overlay marking the search button's clickable area and a point marking the optimal click center.
visual_prior_specs.draw_instructions: Draw a green rectangular bounding box around the second icon from the left (the magnifying glass), matching the rounded square outline of the button. Draw a red dot exactly in the center of this green bounding box.
visual_prior_specs.visual_rationale: Demonstrates the exact spatial extent of the clickable hitbox relative to the icon graphic, and the optimal center point for a click action, which prose cannot convey precisely.
text_exclusions: Do not add text labels like 'Search' or 'Click Here'
Do not write coordinates on the image
forbidden_elements: Extra UI elements not in the source image

text_to_visual_binding: The 'search button' in text refers to the icon enclosed by the green rectangle in the reference overlay.
The 'click center' refers to the red dot.
task_binding_rules: Locate the magnifying glass icon in the target UI.
Estimate the bounding box matching the green rectangle's proportions.
Output the coordinates corresponding to the red dot's relative position.
anti_leakage_rules: Do not output the exact coordinates from the reference image; calculate them for the target image.

usage_constraints: The target image must contain a visible toolbar with a magnifying glass icon.

assets.description: The provided toolbar screenshot with a bounding box overlay marking the search button's clickable area and a point marking the optimal click center.
